tasks.description: Design and implement a passwordless authentication system using magic email links. This system should send a one-time login link to the user's email address and sign them in when clicked. Ensure the system does not store passwords and maintains a high level of security.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address.
Given a valid one-time login link, when the user clicks the link, then the user is signed in.

tasks.description: Design and implement a login screen that presents a username field and does not include a password field, as the system is passwordless. Ensure the screen is accessible, mobile-friendly, and localized.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen, then the screen displays a username field and no password field.
Given the login screen, when the user views the screen on a mobile device, then the screen is mobile-friendly.

tasks.description: Implement a system that sends a one-time login link to the user's email address when the user requests to log in. Ensure the link is valid for a limited time and can only be used once.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address within a reasonable time frame.
Given a one-time login link, when the user clicks the link, then the link can only be used once.

tasks.description: Implement a system that expires session tokens after a period of inactivity. Ensure the expiration time is configurable and the system can handle multiple types of session tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given a session token, when the user is inactive for the expiration time, then the session token is expired.
Given a session token, when the user is active, then the session token is not expired.

tasks.description: Implement a feature flag that controls the rollout of the new authentication system. Ensure the flag can be easily toggled on and off and that the system can handle multiple feature flags.
acceptance_criteria: Given the feature flag, when the flag is toggled on, then the new authentication system is enabled.
Given the feature flag, when the flag is toggled off, then the new authentication system is disabled.

tasks.description: Implement a system that collects metrics on login success rate and time-to-login. Ensure the system can handle large amounts of data and that the metrics are easily accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Given a login attempt, when the attempt is successful, then the login success rate metric is updated.
Given a login attempt, when the attempt is successful, then the time-to-login metric is updated.

tasks.description: Implement a system that rolls out the new authentication system to 10% of users first. Ensure the system can handle multiple rollout percentages and that the rollout is easily configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the rollout system, when the rollout is enabled, then 10% of users are using the new authentication system.
Given the rollout system, when the rollout is disabled, then 0% of users are using the new authentication system.

tasks.description: Fix the login screen to not display a password field, as the system is passwordless. Ensure the screen is updated to only display a username field.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen, then the screen does not display a password field.

tasks.description: Implement localization for the login screen and other authentication-related screens. Ensure the system can handle multiple languages and that the localization is easily configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen in a different language, then the screen is translated correctly.
Given the login screen, when the user views the screen in the default language, then the screen is displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Implement accessibility features for the login screen and other authentication-related screens. Ensure the system can handle multiple accessibility features and that the features are easily configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen with accessibility features enabled, then the screen is accessible.
Given the login screen, when the user views the screen with accessibility features disabled, then the screen is not accessible.

tasks.description: Implement mobile-friendliness for the login screen and other authentication-related screens. Ensure the system can handle multiple mobile devices and that the mobile-friendliness is easily configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen on a mobile device, then the screen is mobile-friendly.
Given the login screen, when the user views the screen on a non-mobile device, then the screen is not mobile-friendly.
